item.title: [−1] Sensex falls 429 points to 72,638.70 and Nifty 0.76% to 22,603.05 after the RBI hike
item.description:
Ends a two-day rally. The auto index fell 1.6%, realty 1.8% and FMCG 0.9% as the RBI moved to 'calibrated tightening' and called the inflation outlook 'no longer benign'. Ongoing pressure.

Autos: mild headwind (−1) — Auto index down 1.6%

Why it matters: Rate-sensitive sectors reprice for dearer loans and slower spending; a tighter stance keeps valuations under pressure while oil stays high.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: days
